index.title: IMPORT PLAN

sheets.title: WHICH SHEETS?

permission.title: CAMERA ACCESS

camera.access: So you can take photos of your plan. They stay on your device until you import them.

limit.message: You can import again tomorrow. Until then, you can build your plan yourself.
